h1.cap: The person who always agrees with you... might be your biggest risk.

n2.cap: Machiavelli called flatterers a pest... and said courts are full of them.

n3.cap: A captain shares his plan. Everyone says... great idea! Nobody mentions the weak defence... until match day.

n4.cap: Take Emperor Maximilian. He kept his plans secret... and asked nobody for advice.

q1.cap: A man close to him said... "He consulted with no one, yet never got his own way in anything."

n5.cap: His plans came out... his people pushed back... he gave in. Done one day... undone the next.

n6.cap: Shutting people out isn't the answer. Pick wise people... ask them everything... then decide yourself.

q2.cap: "The more freely he shall speak, the more he shall be preferred."

n7.cap: Reward whoever brings bad news... and bad news stops hiding.

n8.cap: This morning, ask someone you trust... what am I getting wrong? Then just listen.

n9.cap: Who always tells you the truth? Shout them out in the comments.

n10.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and keep honest people close.
